note: Rewritten from Ahmad's 1965 description of the new species, the original in English; for the new species the original gives only one comparative sentence (close to the soldiers of O. parvidens and O. karnyi) and the measurement table TABLE 13, Measurements ... of 10 Soldiers, with no prose morphological description, so this entry contains measurements only. The holotype is from Mae Sot, Thailand (spelled Maesod in the original).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier close to those of Odontotermes parvidens Holmgren and Holmgren and O. karnyi Kemner; the original gives no verbal morphological description, only a measurement table (TABLE 13, 10 soldiers).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements (mm; in order holotype, range, mean): head length to the lateral mandible base 2.34 (2.23—2.39, 2.30); head width at the lateral mandible base 1.19 (1.14—1.19, 1.16); head width at the posterolateral end of the antennal carina 1.61 (1.53—1.63, 1.57); maximum head width 1.87 (1.79—1.87, 1.82); left mandible length 1.24 (1.14—1.30, 1.18); distance from the marginal tooth of the left mandible to the apical tooth 0.70 (0.65—0.70, 0.68); postmentum length 1.45 (1.37—1.53, 1.42); postmentum width 0.67 (0.65—0.70, 0.67); pronotal length 0.72 (0.65—0.72, 0.68); pronotal width 1.37 (1.27—1.37, 1.31).
